rationale: The only implementation delta is the allocation size: the fixed version allocates at least tile_image->columns * tile_image->rows XCFPixelInfo elements, whereas the vulnerable version allocates only data_length elements. The Logic section says only that memory is allocated, pixel data is read, and data is processed by image type with allocation/error handling. It does not specify the allocation bound, its relationship to tile dimensions, or any safety guard unique to either version. All stated behavior is shared by both implementations.
